summary: Tested Asaas gateway integration (backend + admin UI). Found 1 CRITICAL blocking bug in backend model (IntegrationsConfig missing new Asaas fields — silently discarded on PUT and also wiped existing PagBank credentials). Applied minor schema fix to unblock testing. After the fix, 13/13 backend pytest cases pass covering integrations persistence, /admin/asaas/status, order creation branching (Asaas no-token error path + PagBank regression), webhook auth (missing/wrong/empty token → 401), webhook happy path (PAYMENT_RECEIVED sets order.status=PAID and triggers credential generation via _apply_status_to_order), webhook idempotency (duplicate:true on 2nd call with same event.id), and register-webhook admin endpoint 400 validations. Frontend /admin/integrations UI verified: gateway selector + Asaas card render, all data-testids present, values persist across reload, dropdown changes gateway.

critical.issue: IntegrationsConfig Pydantic model in /app/backend/models.py did NOT include payment_gateway, asaas_environment, asaas_sandbox_token, asaas_production_token, asaas_webhook_token. Because Pydantic silently drops unknown fields AND the route writes model_dump() (all fields with defaults) to Mongo, sending the frontend payload (1) wiped all Asaas keys, (2) OVERWROTE existing pagbank_email + pagbank_token + pagbank_v2_token with empty strings — a live-data destructive regression. FIXED by adding those 5 fields to IntegrationsConfig (see updated_files).

minor.issue: When Asaas checkout fails (e.g., token missing), the DB is updated with gateway='asaas' but the JSON response body omits the `gateway` field (only sets it in the success branch of the local dict). Cosmetic — DB is correct; frontend that refetches via /api/orders/{id} sees it correctly.
No test for PUBLIC_BASE_URL missing branch performed (env is set in this environment). Would require unsetting env + backend restart.

action_items: Review the IntegrationsConfig fix I applied in /app/backend/models.py (added payment_gateway + 4 asaas_* fields with defaults). Consider making the PUT partial-update (patch) instead of overwriting with model_dump() to avoid future field-drop regressions — right now any missing field in the frontend payload resets to Pydantic default and CAN wipe production data.
Optional: in orders_routes.py Asaas failure branch, set order['gateway']='asaas' on the local dict so the response body mirrors DB state.

Live Asaas checkout success path was not tested (no sandbox token). Once real credentials are configured, main agent should manually verify: (a) Asaas checkout URL is returned and stored, (b) end-to-end webhook from Asaas Sandbox reaches /api/webhook/asaas.
critical_code_review_comments: SCHEMA/PYDANTIC: update_integrations uses `payload.model_dump()` and $set with all keys — any field added on the frontend but missing on the Pydantic model is silently discarded, AND any existing field not sent (or reset to default) is CLOBBERED. This exact mechanism just wiped a live PagBank token during my first PUT. Consider `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` on a partial model, or an explicit whitelist merge. Same class of issue exists for other admin config endpoints — worth a broader audit.

ORDER RESPONSE INCONSISTENCY: create_order asaas-failure branch updates DB with gateway='asaas' but doesn't mirror on `order` dict → response missing `gateway`. Not blocking but leads to confusing client state until refetch.
REGISTER-WEBHOOK: services/asaas.register_webhook is not idempotent — calling twice will create duplicate webhooks in Asaas. Consider listing existing and reusing, or storing the returned webhook id.

WEBHOOK EVENT FILTER: PAID_EVENTS includes CHECKOUT_PAID but Asaas typically fires PAYMENT_CONFIRMED / PAYMENT_RECEIVED; CHECKOUT_PAID appears in register_webhook events list too. Verify against Asaas docs that CHECKOUT_PAID event name is correct — otherwise checkout completions might be missed.

ASAAS BASE URL: Sandbox base is `https://api-sandbox.asaas.com/v3` — official Asaas sandbox is `https://sandbox.asaas.com/api/v3`. Please double-check current Asaas documentation, as our current constant may 404.
CUSTOMER PHONE: create_checkout passes customer_phone default '' — find_or_create_customer may still send phone key with empty digits. Small hygiene issue.

rca of the issue: IntegrationsConfig model in models.py was not updated when the Asaas feature was added. Because PUT /api/admin/integrations rebuilds the doc from `payload.model_dump()` (all defined fields, defaults applied) and $sets it wholesale, any field that isn't declared on the model is dropped, and — worse — any field the client omits comes back as its Pydantic default (empty strings for tokens). Two side-effects: (1) Asaas config could never persist, (2) saving from the Asaas UI without also re-sending PagBank fields would wipe production PagBank tokens. Fix applied: added the 5 missing Optional fields with safe defaults. Longer-term fix recommended: switch to partial/PATCH semantics.
